## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

1. Global Risk Regime?
CAUTION. Breadth: 4/11 sectors positive. VXX (1W: -5.75% | 1M: -29.43%) BELOW TREND and HYG (1W: +0.16% | 1M: +1.27%) ABOVE TREND confirm falling fear and easing credit, but narrow breadth and mixed sector returns keep the regime cautious.

2. Primary Risk Drivers?
Falling fear: VXX (1W: -5.75% | 1M: -29.43%) BELOW TREND ↓ falling. Credit stress easing: HYG (1W: +0.16% | 1M: +1.27%) ABOVE TREND and LQD (1W: +0.24% | 1M: +0.40%) ABOVE TREND → flat. Stocks vs bonds neutral-to-tentative: SPY (1W: +0.27% | 1M: +4.61%) ABOVE TREND vs TLT (1W: +0.56% | 1M: -1.15%) RECOVERY — SPY/TLT in CORRECTION.

3. Financial Conditions Signal?
Neutral-leaning: UUP (1W: +0.50% | 1M: -1.20%) RECOVERY and TLT (1W: +0.56% | 1M: -1.15%) RECOVERY show mild dollar and duration stabilization while the yield curve is in RECOVERY.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

4. Sector Leadership?
Mixed/rotation: Technology leading but breadth narrow — XLK (1W: +1.62% | 1M: +6.26%) ABOVE TREND, XLY (1W: +0.10% | 1M: +10.19%) ABOVE TREND, XLF (1W: -0.27% | 1M: +7.30%) CORRECTION, XLU (1W: -1.37% | 1M: -3.14%) BELOW TREND. Style: growth/tech showing strength, but sector breadth confirms caution.

5. US vs Global?
US slightly ahead: SPY (1W: +0.27% | 1M: +4.61%) ABOVE TREND and QQQ (1W: +1.07% | 1M: +5.36%) ABOVE TREND outperformed EM and China — EEM (1W: +0.76% | 1M: +2.60%) ABOVE TREND and FXI (1W: +0.72% | 1M: +1.14%) ABOVE TREND show recovery but less momentum than US tech.

6. Speculative Appetite?
Speculation intact: ARKK (1W: +1.38% | 1M: +11.92%) ABOVE TREND and IBIT (1W: +2.57% | 1M: +1.94%) ABOVE TREND rising; IWM (1W: -0.12% | 1M: +9.83%) in CORRECTION signals selective small-cap strength with short-term pullbacks.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

7. Commodities Theme?
Precious metals and base metals strong: SLV (1W: +4.85% | 1M: +33.09%) ABOVE TREND and CPER (1W: +1.36% | 1M: +9.20%) ABOVE TREND show commodity reflation, GLD (1W: +0.81% | 1M: +6.45%) ABOVE TREND confirms safe-haven bid.

8. Energy Trend?
Energy weakening: XLE (1W: -2.35% | 1M: -0.68%) BELOW TREND, UNG (1W: -2.17% | 1M: -15.46%) BELOW TREND; oil proxies like USO (1W: +0.21% | 1M: -3.02%) RECOVERY but overall energy lacks breadth.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

9. Trend Confirmation?
CONFIRMED: Tech leadership — XLK (1W: +1.62% | 1M: +6.26%) ABOVE TREND and QQQ (1W: +1.07% | 1M: +5.36%) ABOVE TREND. DIVERGENCE: XLF (1W: -0.27% | 1M: +7.30%) CORRECTION and TLT (1W: +0.56% | 1M: -1.15%) RECOVERY create a MINOR divergence between sector and duration signals.

10. Portfolio Direction?
Favor exposure to tech/growth ETFs showing strength (XLK, QQQ) while reducing exposure to weak defensives and energy (XLU, XLE); monitor credit spreads and narrow breadth for signs the cautious regime shifts.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Sectors to Watch?
BULLISH: XLK (1W: +1.62% | 1M: +6.26%) ABOVE TREND; XLY (1W: +0.10% | 1M: +10.19%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: XLE (1W: -2.35% | 1M: -0.68%) BELOW TREND; XLU (1W: -1.37% | 1M: -3.14%) BELOW TREND.

12. Commodities to Watch?
BULLISH: SLV (1W: +4.85% | 1M: +33.09%) ABOVE TREND; CPER (1W: +1.36% | 1M: +9.20%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: UNG (1W: -2.17% | 1M: -15.46%) BELOW TREND; UGA (1W: -1.01% | 1M: -7.92%) BELOW TREND.

13. Key Levels?
VXX 20 (complacency threshold) while VXX (1W: -5.75% | 1M: -29.43%) BELOW TREND is falling; HYG/LQD ratio ~0.73 (credit health) with HYG (1W: +0.16% | 1M: +1.27%) ABOVE TREND; XLK/XLF tech vs financials at ~2.64 (Tech lead) with XLK ABOVE TREND and XLF CORRECTION; SPY/TLT ~7.77 in CORRECTION.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

CAUTION. Breadth: 4/11 sectors positive, falling VXX and improving HYG/LQD signal lower fear but narrow market participation. Technology and selective cyclicals showing relative strength (XLK, QQQ, XLY); energy and utilities showing weakness (XLE, XLU). Key divergence to monitor: XLF CORRECTION vs TLT RECOVERY — narrow breadth could turn a rally fragile.
